svg.title: How CloudTrain works
svg.desc: People use the web app; the gateway signs them in through Keycloak and their company identity provider, stores data in Postgres with per-organisation row-level security, and asks the lab orchestrator for lab and exam sessions. The orchestrator provisions isolated labs (kubeadm clusters on VMs, virtual clusters, routed networks) on Kubernetes with KubeVirt and Kube-OVN, and grades them. Lab content is validated and verified live before it is published.
svg.text: Every learner gets real, isolated infrastructure. The platform grades the end state and feeds a skill model.
Backend for the web app · TypeScript · Fastify
Every lab ships a reference solution, alternative solutions and wrong-approach mutations; it is published only after the live verifier proves all of them.
Learners never see admin credentials: setup and grading run out of band, from a sidecar the learner can't read.
